humanAccess.question: Can a normal user get to the 952 pages?
humanAccess.evidence: Each reachable row has Home, Browse, Search, or incoming detail-link evidence in the runtime audit.

humanAccess.question: How many are front-facing without search?
How many are reachable but not front-facing?
humanAccess.evidence: These are Search-only, Search + related, or related-only rows. They are real app pages, but lower visual priority.

humanAccess.question: How many are in the Search index?
humanAccess.evidence: Search index membership is the baseline proof that a human can intentionally find/open the page.

humanAccess.question: How many look hidden, dead, or legacy-only?
humanAccess.evidence: No needs-backdrop row lacked Home, Browse, Search, or detail-link coverage in this audit.

humanAccess.question: How many should be reviewed for delete/archive because they are inaccessible?
humanAccess.evidence: Deletion is not recommended from reachability evidence unless this count becomes nonzero.

humanAccess.question: What about support/reference rows?
humanAccess.evidence: These are not first-pass traveler UI rows, but they are not dead rows in this audit.

searchAudit.question: Are the 563 Search/search+related pages bloat?
searchAudit.decision: They are live Search-indexed phrase pages, usually long-tail exact traveler needs. Keep the long-tail rows searchable instead of forcing them into Home/Browse.

searchAudit.question: How many should be kept Search-only?
searchAudit.decision: These are mostly premium exact-need rows. Add broad/category backdrops, but do not promote every one into top-level navigation.

searchAudit.question: How many should be promoted or reviewed?
searchAudit.decision: These are tier-one or major travel-flow pages. They should be reviewed for Browse/Home/category surfacing after the image pass.

searchAudit.question: How many should be deleted or archived now?
searchAudit.decision: Zero from this audit. Every row resolves to a canonical runtime page, Search index entry, and bundled audio.

searchAudit.question: Do they have audio?
searchAudit.decision: All Search/search+related rows have ready audio and an existing file under native-ios/Resources/Audio.

searchAudit.question: What about legacy-looking IDs?
searchAudit.decision: They are not stale by themselves. They resolve through page_alias to canonical runtime page IDs, so do not delete them based on the old ID shape.

searchAudit.question: Premium vs starter split
searchAudit.decision: This explains why many pages are Search-only: premium exact-need coverage is intentionally broader than curated Home/Browse shelves.

searchAudit.question: Runtime/audio problems found
searchAudit.decision: No Search-only row needs runtime/audio repair before backdrop work.
